answer: Identities open a behavior-fingerprint escrow: deposit 40 credits, locked 20 epochs, released only for consistent activity. A lantern ledger publishes patterns, and a prism check splits them into facets — timing, counterparties, task mix — so a copy matching one facet still fails the rest. Faking 100 identities costs 4,000 credits and 2,000 epochs of mimicry; shortcuts collapse like a karst sinkhole. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
